label: The mechanism, not the rate, is the complaint
text: Economists heard in the 26–27 Oct cycle argue the way the excess-profit base is computed is inflationary, and the EY reading of the ZKPO draft adds the second-order items: a one-off super-profit levy, changed global-minimum-tax rules, loss carry-forward extended to 10 years (capped at 70 % of annual profit), and higher taxation of food vouchers and private use of company assets.
